3.0 Production Flow Procedure

PhaseRequirements
STARTUP• Start line at low speed
• Verify all stations running
• Check first 5 pieces at each station
• Ramp up to production speed
• Verify quality at full speed
• Document startup checks
STEADY-STATE• Maintain specified cycle times
• Perform quality checks per schedule
• Monitor material levels
• Address jams/issues immediately
• Communicate issues to team lead
• Document production counts
CHANGEOVER | • Clear line of previous product• Perform changeover per procedure
• Verify new materials at stations
• Update documentation
• First piece inspection required
• Document changeover time
